t: A hands-on activity where students train a small car to drive itself from camera images.
steps: Open the Donkey Car Robot Day activity page and the AI Racing League site.
Build or borrow a Donkey Car with an RC chassis, a Raspberry Pi 4, and a camera.
Ask IT to help with the Raspberry Pi setup.
Drive the car around a track to collect images.
Train the network and run the car on its own.
